نستلم (form VIII)
# نَسْتَلِمُ (nastalimu) /nas.ta.li.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
# نُسْتَلَمُ (nustalamu) /nus.ta.la.mu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
# نَسْتَلِمَ (nastalima) /nas.ta.li.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
# نُسْتَلَمَ (nustalama) /nus.ta.la.ma/:
